$Comment: The quest that hands a new player the Sawmill: gather the makings, then deliver them to Sawyer
Marn in the Forgotten Temple. It opens once meet_at_the_temple is claimed, because Marn stands
in the temple and nowhere else; a quest whose giver the player cannot reach would sit parked
and unpaid. It is the first rung of the sawmill chain, so the quest book lists its successors
under it.
Both gathering steps sit on Order 1, so the wood and the planks can be worked in either order;
the delivery step is Order 2 and only unlocks once both are done. Its own TurnInNpcId 'giver'
locks the hand-in to Npc.ViewId (Marn), so the planks can only be delivered to him. The reward
sits in the Claim bucket, so the Sawmill and the Woodcutting XP wait in the quest log once that
delivery is made, until the player collects them themselves. CompletionDialogue names Marn's own
conversation, so settling it at him plays his next line, which is where he offers the next job.
Target 'Wood' on the chop step and '_Planks' on the craft and delivery steps both match on
CONTAINS, so every wood species counts toward the total rather than one specific type; '_Planks'
also happens to catch the half-plank cut of each species, which is a fair reading of 'planks'.
The planks here are hand-bench planks (CRAFT_ITEM): nobody owns a mill yet, and that is the
point of the quest.
Requires.Factors carries the stations feature, which is on when RPG Stations is installed and
enabled; with it off this quest does not exist, and neither does Marn.
AutoAccept is off deliberately: this is an optional beat off the main tutorial branch, offered
from Marn's own lines once the temple has been reached, not forced on everybody.
To retune the grind, edit the three Amounts; to change the payout, edit Rewards - the Sawmill
itself is the first entry, so replacing or removing it changes what this quest is actually for.
